MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Liquid electrical tape and electronic cleaner feel useful alongside my crimp connectors because they help insulate and maintain electrical connections.",
    "The general repair epoxy fits the practical bonding needs suggested by my duct tape and vinyl cement purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Nuts, washers, and screws need to match specific dimensions for a repair; buying clamps does not tell me these particular sizes will fit anything I need.",
    "Cutting wheels and flap discs assume both a compatible grinder and a cutting or sanding job, neither of which my purchases establish.",
    "WaterWeld sounds relevant to repairs, but without a wet-area repair I would choose the general epoxy first."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in repair supplies seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop hardware.",
    "My purchases of supply packs seem to have been taken as a reason to suggest bulk quantities even when the exact part has no established use for me."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection between my purchases is what they help me do: bond materials, secure hoses, and make electrical connections.",
    "Exact fit and tool compatibility matter before I would choose specialized hardware or consumables.",
    "I choose supplies when they address a practical need; a broadly related repair product is less compelling without a reason to use it now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but assumed too much about the specific hardware and tools my repairs require."
}
